2200: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and your arms by your sides.
Brace your core and press your heels into the ball.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top for a second.
Lower your hips slowly without letting the ball drift away.
Repeat for the planned reps, keeping the ball steady.
2202: Start by sitting on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place the roller under your glutes, just above your knees.
Lean back and place your hands on the ground behind you for support.
Engage your glutes and slowly roll the roller forward, bending your knees and bringing them towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
Slowly roll the roller back to the starting position, extending your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2203: Sit on a flat surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the roller with both hands, palms facing down, and place it on your thighs.
Lean forward slightly and roll the roller away from your body, extending your arms straight in front of you.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the roller back towards your body, bending your arms and bringing the roller back to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2204: Start in a plank position with your forearms on the roller and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and slowly roll the roller forward, extending your body as far as you can while maintaining control.
Pause for a moment at the furthest point, then slowly roll the roller back towards your starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2205: Start by kneeling on the ground with the roller positioned under your hips.
Place your hands on the roller for support.
Slowly roll the roller forward, extending your hips and stretching your glutes.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then roll back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2206: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended straight above your head and your legs straight out in front of you.
Place the roller between your feet and grip it with your toes.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs off the ground and curl your knees towards your chest, rolling the roller towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position, rolling the roller away from your body.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2207: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the roller with both hands in front of your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms forward and roll the roller down towards your feet, feeling a stretch in your lats.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly roll the roller back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2208: Start by sitting on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place the roller perpendicular to your body, just below your glutes.
Slowly roll your body backwards, allowing the roller to move up your back.
Continue rolling until the roller reaches your upper back.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2209: Sit on a flat surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the roller with both hands, palms facing down, and place it on your thighs.
Lean back slightly and engage your core muscles.
Raise the roller up to shoulder level, keeping your arms straight.
Slowly lower the roller back down to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2224: Sit in the seat with your back and head flat against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety handles and lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the pad as you descend.
Push through your whole foot to extend your legs without locking your knees.
2234: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and avoid shrugging.
Lower slowly to the start and repeat.
2249: Attach a V bar to a high pulley and stand facing the stack.
Grip the bar with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are fully straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment at the bottom.
Let the bar rise until your forearms are just past parallel.
Keep your upper arms still throughout the set.
2258: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and your gaze ahead.
Start walking with a natural stride.
Swing your arms gently opposite to your legs.
Land softly on your heel and roll through to the toes.
Keep a pace that lets you breathe comfortably.
2259: Step onto the belt and hold the rails while you start at a slow speed.
Increase to a comfortable walking pace.
Let go of the rails and swing your arms naturally.
Keep your head up and your steps even.
Add some incline if you want more challenge.
Walk for 20-45 minutes and slow down before stepping off.
2265: Adjust the seat and chest pad, then sit with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your torso by driving the elbows back.
Return slowly until your arms are straight again.
2266: Adjust the machine and sit with your back against the pad.
Cross your arms or hold the handles as the machine allows.
Push back by extending at the hips and lower back.
Stop when your torso is in a neutral, tall position.
2267: Adjust the seat and sit with your back flat against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Push through your heels until your legs are nearly straight.
Bend your knees slowly to return.
2268: Sit on the machine and adjust the seat so your hands reach the pad.
Place your hands on the pads and brace your feet.
Curl your torso forward by contracting your abs.
Return slowly to the upright start.
2269: Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel with both hands in front of your knees.
Round your lower back slightly and brace your abs.
Roll forward a short distance while keeping your hips stable.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Exhale as you crunch and avoid arching your back.
2271: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Keep your left hand up to protect your face and your right hand by your chin.
Rotate your hips and pivot on your left foot as you extend your left arm forward in a punching motion.
Twist your torso and engage your core muscles to generate power in the punch.
Snap your arm back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2272: Stand in a boxing stance with your lead foot forward and hands up by your chin.
Extend your lead hand straight toward the target.
Rotate your fist so the palm faces down as it lands.
Keep your chin tucked and your rear hand guarding.
Snap the hand back to the guard quickly.
Repeat, then switch stance if you want.
2273: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Push off the back foot and rotate your hips and shoulders.
Throw your rear hand straight toward the target.
Keep your lead hand up to protect your chin.
Pull the hand back along the same line.
Return to your stance and repeat.
2274: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your right side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your right fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your left hand guarding your chin.
2275: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Bend your knees slightly and dip your left side.
Drive up through your legs as you rotate your hips.
Throw your left fist upward with the palm facing you.
Keep your right hand guarding your chin.
2276: Lie back on the machine and place your hands or arms as indicated.
Hook your feet or grip the handles for stability.
Curl your torso up by contracting your abs.
Lower slowly back to the start.
2277: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pulled together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
2278: Adjust the seat and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows bent.
Press forward and slightly downward until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your shoulders down and your chest up.
2279: Adjust the seat so your knees stay slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke.
Hold the handles and sit tall.
Start pedalling at an easy pace to warm up.
Raise the speed to a brisk rhythm you can sustain.
Continue for 10-30 minutes, then slow down to cool off.
2282: Set the weight light and adjust the pad to rest on the back of your head.
Sit tall and bring your chin slightly down.
Press your head back against the pad slowly.
Move only through a comfortable range.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.
2283: Set the weight light and position the pad against the left side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the left against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.
2284: Set the weight light and position the pad against the right side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.
2285: Adjust the seat and handles of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grasp the handles with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms slightly bent and your core engaged.
Slowly pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your lats.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2286: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your feet on the footrests and grip the handles for stability.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then push against the footrests to extend your hips and raise your legs backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2287: Adjust the seat and foot platform of the leverage machine to your desired position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the foot platform.
Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push one foot against the foot platform, extending your leg until it is almost fully straight.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bend your leg and return to the starting position.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
2288: Adjust the seat height and grip the handles of the leverage machine.
Keep your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Exhale and squeeze the handles, contracting your forearms.
Hold the contraction for a second, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2289: Adjust the seat of the leverage machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Place your toes on the lever pad, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or side supports for stability.
Push the lever pad down by extending your ankles, contracting your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position by allowing your heels to rise back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2290: Stand a stride length in front of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee tracking over your toes.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
2291: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Control the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
2292: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2293: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Place your upper arms against the preacher bench and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders while keeping your upper arms stationary.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing downward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, rotating your wrists back to the starting position as well.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2294: Sit on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up and elbows resting on the pad.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms stationary and your palms facing up.
At the top of the curl, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing down.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, rotating your wrists back to the starting position as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2296: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms on it.
Brace your abs and keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms and body.
Stop when you feel your core working hard without your back sagging.
Pull the ball back by squeezing your abs.
2297: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly curl your upper body forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
2298: Set up a bench at a height that allows your body to hang freely underneath it.
Lie face up on the ground with your head towards the bench.
Reach up and grab the bench with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your body so that your heels are on the ground and your arms are fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull your chest up towards the bench.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
